items.a: It is a good idea in the evening and during the big trade fairs at Paris Expo, when the area fills up. Book online or call +33 9 87 76 60 20. Without a booking, we will seat you if there is room.

items.q: Do you take groups and companies?
items.a: Yes: team lunches, exhibitor dinners, birthdays and private hire. Send the date, number of guests and budget with the group form and we will reply with a proposal.
Yes: vegetarian burger, burrata and tomatoes, tomato and mozzarella, artichoke heart salad, egg mayonnaise, cheese and desserts. Let us know about any dietary needs when you book.

items.q: Do you have a children's menu?
items.a: There is a kids' burger (chicken, cheddar sauce, fries) at €12.90. Le Dôme is a family restaurant and children are welcome.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Visa, Mastercard and American Express cards, cash and French meal vouchers.

items.q: Do you speak English or Spanish?
items.a: This website and the whole menu are available in French, English and Spanish: keep it open on your phone when you order. For written requests, write to us in the language you prefer.
Yes, the restaurant is accessible to people with reduced mobility. Let us know when you book and we will prepare a convenient table.

portedeversailles.h1: A French restaurant at Porte de Versailles
portedeversailles.intro: Bistrot Le Dôme is at 6 rue du Hameau in the 15th arrondissement, a few minutes' walk from place de la Porte de Versailles.

p: Black shopfront, midnight-blue awning, bistro chairs and golden pendant lights: Le Dôme looks just like you would expect a Parisian bistro to look. Neighbours come for lunch, friends for dinner, and the bar stays open for an aperitif.

The menu sticks to the classics: snails in garlic and parsley butter, egg mayonnaise, beef bourguignon, duck confit with Sarlat potatoes, French rib-eye with pepper sauce. For dessert, crème brûlée, homemade tiramisu and chocolate fondant.
If you prefer, there are also Angus beef burgers, main-course salads and sharing boards.
Metro Porte de Versailles (line 12) or tram T2 and T3a, then a few minutes on foot. The restaurant is open every day.

parisexpo.h1: A restaurant 5 minutes from Paris Expo
parisexpo.intro: Exhibiting or visiting a trade fair at Porte de Versailles? From boulevard Lefebvre, walk up rue de la Croix-Nivert: Le Dôme is at the top of rue du Hameau, 5 minutes on foot.

p: Allow 5 minutes on foot from boulevard Lefebvre, opposite the halls, via rue de la Croix-Nivert, and about 7 minutes from the main entrance on place de la Porte de Versailles.

At lunchtime the area is busy on trade-fair days: book, even for two. Tell us if you have a meeting on your stand and we will do our best to serve you in time. The dish of the day is posted on this website every morning.
In the evening, Le Dôme welcomes exhibitor teams and the clients they invite. For a group, send the date, number of guests and budget: we will suggest a menu and a single bill if needed.
